tvShow.name: Ascendance of a Bookworm
tvShow.originalName: 本好きの下剋上 司書になるためには手段を選んでいられません
tvShow.overview: When a sickly young girl suddenly becomes obsessed with inventing new things, her family and friends are all puzzled. "What has gotten into Myne?" they wondered, never dreaming that the answer is not a "What" but a "Who": Urano Motosu, a book-loving apprentice librarian who died in an earthquake in Tokyo who somehow found herself in Myne's body! And since Myne's world is still in a medieval stage, where books can only be owned by the elite, the new Myne intends to do everything she can to bring her beloved books to the masses in the time she has left.

episodes.name: Side Story One: Eustachius's Incognito Operation Downtown
episodes.overview: The head priest wants more information on Main, so he sends two of his aides, Eckhard and Eustachius, to investigate her.

episodes.name: Side Story Two: Visiting Missus Corinna
episodes.overview: Eva and Turi find themselves having to accompany Main to Corinna's residence, because she wants to take a look at the outfit Main wore for her baptism.

episodes.name: Re-Ascendance of a Bookworm (1)
episodes.overview: Main begins her journey to create paper, facing setbacks and revealing her true self to Lutz.

guest_stars.character: Old man of the store / Gray Priest (voice)
guest_stars.name: Takugo Iwakawa

episodes.name: Re-Ascendance of a Bookworm (2)
episodes.overview: Main faces challenges as she takes over the orphanage, aiming to help the kids while uncovering dark secrets.

episodes.name: A World Without Books
episodes.overview: Motosu Urano, a college student and a bookworm of the highest order, loses her life in an avalanche of books and wakes up in another world as a sickly girl named Main. Nevertheless confident that she can deal with any situation as long as she has books to read, she looks all over her new home for one, but doesn't find any. To make matters worse, she couldn't see any writing in town when out with her mother Eva. She realized that she found herself in a world with a low literacy rate, one where books were prohibitively expensive.

episodes.name: Life Improvements and Slates
episodes.overview: Having learned how expensive books are in this world, Main resolves to make books of her own. However, she soon finds out just how frail her new body is when she and her elder sister, Turi, decide to go to the gate to deliver something their father forgot—she can hardly take a few steps before running out of breath. But that's when Lutz, a neighborhood kid the same age as Main, offers his help. Main is touched by this and soon makes it to the gate. There, Otto gives her his old slate, letting her experience the joy of writing once again

episodes.name: The Events of Winter
episodes.overview: While everyone is snowed in by the harsh winter, Main has a plan: a plan to craft pseudo-papyrus as the first step towards making a book. Meanwhile, Eva teaches Turi a bunch of skills in order to prepare her for her upcoming baptism in the summer. Main is told to think about where she wants to apprentice, but as always, books are the only thing on her mind. As winter rolls on, however, the family bonds and grows closer together, and Main hits upon the perfect gift to give Turi to wear on her baptism day.

episodes.name: Forests and Clay Tablets
episodes.overview: Spring has arrived, and Main is raring to go make clay tablets in the forest. But first, she must convince her family that she can handle the journey.

episodes.name: Baptisms and Strange Fevers
episodes.overview: The season has shifted to summer, and the day of Turi's baptism has arrived. Turi attracts attention with a hair ornament made by Main. Main, who has more opportunities to go to the forest, starts making wooden tablets with the help of Lutz. Meanwhile, Lutz asks Main Lutz to let him meet Otto. Lutz had a dream of becoming a traveling merchant. However, Main, shocked by her repeated failures at making paper, collapses from a high fever before the meeting with Otto.

episodes.name: Meeting
episodes.overview: Lutz and Main prepare for the meeting with Otto. But Otto brings someone with him, turning a casual meeting into an interview that will decide both Lutz and Main's futures.

episodes.name: Seeds of Suspicion
episodes.overview: With the paper-making process about to begin, Main can't hide her excitement as she and Lutz go to meet Benno as per his invitation. He reveals that he is willing to arrange for all the equipment and materials they need to make paper, but the ensuing conversation makes Lutz see Main in a very different light.

episodes.name: Lutz's Main
episodes.overview: As Main and Lutz begin making their paper for real, Main's excitement gets the better of her, and Lutz's suspicions come to a head. He resolves to talk to her about it after the paper is finished.

episodes.name: The Guild Master's Granddaughter
episodes.overview: Benno looks to have Main and Lutz registered with the Merchant Guild, but the guild master proves to be an obstacle. This results in them making plans to meet Frieda, his granddaughter.

episodes.name: To the Second Winter
episodes.overview: Main learns from Frieda that the illness she has is called the Devouring, and that it will flare up if she ever feels anxiety or loses hope. Almost on cue, her fever starts acting up...

episodes.name: Life-or-Death Choices and Family Meetings
episodes.overview: With Main collapses, everyone she knows comes together in a bid to save her life. But soon, she is faced with a life-or-death decision, one that she must discuss with her family.

episodes.name: Baptism and Divine Paradises
episodes.overview: The day of Main and Lutz's baptism has arrived. Wearing a fancy dress and a new hair ornament, Main appears a clear standout from the rest of the kids, but soon she loses her way and finds herself in what she sees as heaven on earth.

episodes.name: The Choice to Be an Apprentice Priestess
episodes.overview: When Main brings up wanting to become an apprentice priestess to her family, she learns the truth about the role and what it entails and soon comes to realize that she is in for the fight of her life.

episodes.name: Conclusions
episodes.overview: Main, Gunther, and Eva head to the cathedral for their fateful meeting, knowing that Main's life is riding on a successful negotiation. But will things really go so smoothly for them?

episodes.name: Apprentice Priestess
episodes.overview: Main is now an apprentice priestess at the cathedral. How will she adapt to a new life in new surroundings, and how will they react to her?

episodes.name: Blue Robes and Uncommon Sense
episodes.overview: The stark contrast of the values at the church compared to life downtown continues to bewilder Main, as she butts heads with her retainers and her expected duties at the church.

episodes.name: Needs
episodes.overview: With Fran now fully on her team, Main must then get to work on winning Gil and Delia over.

episodes.name: Orphanage Reforms
episodes.overview: Main is taken to the orphanage and collapses in shock when she sees the state it and its inhabitants are in. She wants to help the kids, but will she really be able to?

episodes.name: Cleanups and Star Festivals
episodes.overview: As newly appointed orphanage director, Main's first task is to lead a major cleanup of the orphanage and its inhabitants. And as summer comes around, she also has some festivities in mind.

episodes.name: The Path Ahead of Lutz
episodes.overview: The friction in Lutz's family caused by his choice of profession comes to a head, and he runs away from home to get away from it all.

episodes.name: New Retainers
episodes.overview: When Main hears that Eva is pregnant, she decides to make a picture book for the baby and looks to recruit Wilma to be her artist. However, she finds a few roadblocks on her path...

episodes.name: Wilma and Holy Scriptures for Kids
episodes.overview: With the picture-book production in full sway, Main must navigate several hurdles regarding the process and, more pressingly, Wilma's condition.

episodes.name: Harvest Festivals and Staying Home
episodes.overview: The Harvest Festival is here, and Main finds the library ransacked. She is outraged at first, but this may be a welcome opportunity for her...

episodes.name: Knight Orders and Requests
episodes.overview: Main has to break the news to her family that she has to stay in the cathedral over winter. Meanwhile, the request from the knight order looms large over the horizon.

episodes.name: Trombe and Battles
episodes.overview: Main and the head priest set out to join the knights on a mission to take down a rampage trombe. With this being her first exposure to proper noble society, who knows what perils lie in Main's path?

episodes.name: Dreamlike World
episodes.overview: Tasked with healing the land ravaged by the trombe, Main has to put on a show. How that will affect the way the onlookers see her is anybody's guess... and so is how the head priest will react.

episodes.name: The Beginning of Winter
episodes.overview: Autumn has come to a close. Main starts selling the scripture picture books, gets asked by the apprentice blacksmith Johann to be his patron, and starts taking the next step in her bookmaking endeavors. While this is going on, Main finds out that the guild master of the Ink Guild, Wolf, is trying to get information on her. Benno then proposes an idea to Main and...

episodes.name: The Story About Winter Stays and the Future
episodes.overview: Main ends up having to start her winter stay at the cathedral. However, she instantly becomes homesick. Also, in a meeting with Benno, Ferdinand, and Karstedt, it's revealed that Wolf is a dangerous individual with ties to nobles. Apparently, even the nobles are after Main because of her powerful mana and her bizarre knowledge. In order to keep her out of danger, Ferdinand comes up with a proposal, and...

episodes.name: The Dedication Ceremony and Spring Arrives
episodes.overview: The knight Damuel has become Main's bodyguard. Now that she's able to go places, Main is excited about going to the library. They hold the Dedication Ceremony where she offers her mana into small holy grails. That was quite tiring for her, but she still goes back into town to see how Johann is doing with her order. Her passion for books just doesn't top. Spring is drawing closer, and Main can't wait to go back to her family, but then she receives some devastating news.

episodes.name: Spring Prayer
episodes.overview: Main and the others get ready to head off to the Spring Prayer, when they meet a blue-robed priest named Sylvester. Main doesn't know how to deal with Sylvester who seems to do whatever he wants. She tries to avoid Sylvester as they go around to various farming villages and she does an amazing job doing all of the rituals. Eventually, they end up at Viscount Gerlach's mansion. Apparently he had shown interest in Main before. But that night, something terrible happens!

episodes.name: Gift from the Blue-Robed Priest and Going Home
episodes.overview: With the Spring Prayer finished, Main and the others returned to the cathedral. Sylvester appoints Main as his guide to show him around the orphanage and workshop, where they observe how the scripture picture books are made. As he leaves, Sylvester gives Main a necklace with a black stone, saying it's a protection charm just in case anything were to happen. Meanwhile, Ferdinand, who had also witnessed the books being made, tells Main's method of making books will change history and how dangerous that may be.

episodes.name: The Abandoned Child of the Cathedral and Making Colors
episodes.overview: Main is finally able to go home. Her little brother Kamil is born and she becomes even more determined to create books. That is when Main meets a helpful collaborator named Heidi, who is the daughter of an ink maker. Heidi is extremely curious and passionate, so she hit it off immediately with Main. They start to make colored inks through trial and error. Meanwhile, a baby is abandoned at the cathedral and Main and her attendants end up taking care of him.

episodes.name: Delia and Dirk
episodes.overview: Dirk suddenly develops a high fever. Delia, who adored Dirk, and started to see him as her own family, was worried sick. Main sees his symptoms and realizes that he may have the Devouring. After talking to Ferdinand, they decide to raise him without letting others know that he has the Devouring. Meanwhile, Main continues her colored-ink experiments with Heidi as she helped out with taking care of Dirk at the cathedral, but...

episodes.name: Ominous Developments
episodes.overview: On the way home from Heidi's workshop, they hear the emergency bells sound through the city as well as see a red emergency flare go up into the sky. Main is worried about what might've happened. It is decided that Main should stay home until they can find out what is going on. Main gets to spend some time with her family back home again. After a while, Main is finally allowed back outside and heads to the cathedral. Once she gets there, she realizes Dirk is missing, and unbeknownst to her, there was another threat lurking just around the corner!

episodes.name: The Black Protective Charm
episodes.overview: Because of the lack of caution exercised by one of the gate guards, the carriage with the noble from another domain has entered the city. Gunther finds out that Main is being targeted and gets worked up over protecting Main. But then, Main is attacked by some mysterious men. Main believes what Sylvester told her and presses her blood seal upon the black charm he gave her. But then, Main's attackers become even more aggressive. Finally, the high priest's true intentions and his plans with Dirk are revealed.

episodes.name: Blessing
episodes.overview: To protect her family, Main agrees to be adopted by Sylvester. It is he who enters the cathedral with Sir Karstedt just at the moment when Ferdinand and Sir Bindewald are involved in a fight, but this entire affair will not only have consequences for Main because now Count Bindewald, the bishop, and Delia have to answer for their actions.

seasons.name: Ascendance of a Bookworm
seasons.overview: When a sickly young girl suddenly becomes obsessed with inventing new things, her family and friends are all puzzled. "What has gotten into Myne?" they wondered, never dreaming that the answer is not a "What" but a "Who": Urano Motosu, a book-loving apprentice librarian who died in an earthquake in Tokyo who somehow found herself in Myne's body! And since Myne's world is still in a medieval stage, where books can only be owned by the elite, the new Myne intends to do everything she can to bring her beloved books to the masses in the time she has left.

episodes.name: I've Become a Noble
episodes.overview: Myne begins her new life as Rosemyne. Her first challenge is to complete the baptism and adoption ceremonies!

episodes.name: Lower City Family Reunion
episodes.overview: After the baptism ceremony and adoption, Rosemyne returns to the cathedral to become the high bishop.

episodes.name: Archduke's Castle and Italian Restaurant
episodes.overview: Rosemyne officially moves into the castle and Sylvester finally eats at the Italian restaurant.

episodes.name: How to Collect Donations
episodes.overview: Rosemyne tries to collect donations from the nobility, but finds it harder than she thought...

episodes.name: Concert Preparations
episodes.overview: Rosemyne puts all her efforts into preparing for the harspiel concert.

episodes.name: Harspiel Concert
episodes.overview: Everything is falling into place for the concert. All that's left is to guard against one person...

episodes.name: Hasse's Monastery
episodes.overview: The monastery in Hasse is now ready. Rosemyne goes for the final inspection and to accept new children.

episodes.name: Ferdinand's Task
episodes.overview: Ferdinand gives Rosemyne the task to entrap and isolate the mayor of Hasse.

episodes.name: Wilfried's Day as High Bishop
episodes.overview: Rosemyne finally gets fed up with Wilfried's complaints and offers to switch spots with him for a day.

episodes.name: The Gathering of Gutenbergs
episodes.overview: To improve the printing press, Ingo is even willing to exchange ideas between different trades.

episodes.name: The Winter Social Season and Debut
episodes.overview: The winter social season is here and Rosemyne must successfully finish her debut.

episodes.name: Winter Material Gathering
episodes.overview: Rosemyne attempts to gather materials for her jureve once again!

episodes.name: Hasse's Punishment
episodes.overview: Hasse's punishment has finally been decided and Rosemyne must go to witness the results.

episodes.name: Night of Fruhtrane
episodes.overview: Rosemyne must go to the Goddess's Bath on the Night of Fruhtrane to collect the spring material for her jureve.

episodes.name: New Dress and Printing Press
episodes.overview: Brigitte tries on the dress that Rosemyne designed while the printing press is finally ready for a test print.

episodes.name: Holding the Fort During the Archduke Conference
episodes.overview: With the archduke and his wife away, Rozemyne must stay at the castle with Wilfried.

episodes.name: Damuel's Proposal
episodes.overview: The Star-Binding Ceremony begins and Rosemyne hopes Brigitte's new dress will enchant the nobility.

episodes.name: Inspection of Illgner and Gathering of Summer
episodes.overview: Rosemyne and her Gutenberg go to Illgner in hopes of finding new materials for papermaking.
